headline: PASS: 8 of 8 checks pass at desktop and phone widths.
target: local server (python3 -m http.server) on this branch

checks.check: the title screen shows the game, its four coolness tiers and the best score, with nothing loaded from the internet
notes: desktop: 4 tiers (10, 25, 60, 150 points), 12 prizes on the shelf, best score 0; no requests outside the site, no outside links, no sideways scrolling
phone: 4 tiers (10, 25, 60, 150 points), 12 prizes on the shelf, best score 0; no requests outside the site, no outside links, no sideways scrolling

checks.check: DROP puts in a coin, the timer starts, and the keypad and keyboard steer the claw
notes: desktop: a coin went in (10 to 9 coins) and the 15 s timer started; 3 taps on ◀ moved the claw 18 units left; holding W moved it 13.9 units forward; the aim line reads "Steer over a prize, then DROP"
phone: a coin went in (10 to 9 coins) and the 15 s timer started; 3 taps on ◀ moved the claw 18 units left; holding W moved it 13.9 units forward; the aim line reads "Steer over a prize, then DROP"

checks.check: a centred grab carries a prize to the chute and scores its tier's points, and it goes on the collection shelf
notes: desktop: grabbed the planet dead centre: it held, rode to the chute, scored 60 and gave a coin back (10 coins); the shelf shows it x1
phone: grabbed the planet dead centre: it held, rode to the chute, scored 60 and gave a coin back (10 coins); the shelf shows it x1

checks.check: an off-centre grab slips out on the way and the prize falls back into the pile
notes: desktop: dropped 7.5 units off the centre of a duck: the claw closed on it, it slipped out on the way up ("SO CLOSE" on the display), and all 27 prizes are back in the machine; 0 points, 9 coins left
phone: dropped 7.5 units off the centre of a duck: the claw closed on it, it slipped out on the way up ("SO CLOSE" on the display), and all 27 prizes are back in the machine; 0 points, 9 coins left

checks.check: five wins refill the machine for round 2, with more of the coolest prizes and a shorter timer
notes: desktop: 5 cool prizes won (score 50); the machine refilled for round 2: by tier (cool, cooler, super cool, coolest) it went from 15, 8, 3, 1 to 10, 10, 5, 2; the timer is 13 s now (15 s in round 1)
phone: 5 cool prizes won (score 50); the machine refilled for round 2: by tier (cool, cooler, super cool, coolest) it went from 15, 8, 3, 1 to 10, 10, 5, 2; the timer is 13 s now (15 s in round 1)

checks.check: P pauses and freezes the game, Esc resumes, and Start over brings back 10 coins
notes: desktop: paused with 14.1 s on the timer and 3 s of stepping changed nothing; after Esc it counted down again; the Pause button then Start over gave a fresh machine with 10 coins
phone: paused with 14.1 s on the timer and 3 s of stepping changed nothing; after Esc it counted down again; the Pause button then Start over gave a fresh machine with 10 coins

notes: desktop: one coin left: a cat won 25, then OUT OF COINS with NEW BEST; after a reload the title shows best 25 and 1/12 found; save keys: gameon.claw-of-cool.best, gameon.claw-of-cool.collection; with storage blocked a new game still played and scored
